entries.title: Few Additions
changes: Added intro animations that play before an emote's main loop.
Added AudioAfterIntro so an emote's sound can wait until the loop starts.
Added custom IntroAudio for a separate sound during the intro.
Fixed GUI menu paging skipping the last page on some emote counts.

entries.title: More Emotes
changes: Fixed Rebellious using the wrong sound key.
Fixed Icons not rendering for some emotes.

entries.title: GUI Input Mode
changes: Added GUI list menu input mode as an alternative to the wheel.
Added setting to exclude custom emotes from the GUI menu.
Added adjustable emotes-per-page count for the GUI menu.
